name: Anúbis
description: One deliberate attack: draw the staff back, raise it, drive it forward in a forceful strike, then recover to the starting idle stance. The other hand keeps holding the scales, pans sway with the motion. Preserve the exact source sprite identity, outfit, weapons, size and crisp pixel art palette. All motion fits inside the canvas. Fixed front orthographic camera, no translation, no rotation of camera, no zoom, transparent background.
